title: UnitedHealthcare Medicare Coverage
summary: Landing page that introduces UnitedHealthcare's four Medicare plan families: Medicare Advantage, Medicare Supplement, Part D prescription drug plans, and Dual Special Needs plans.

atoms.title: What Medicare Advantage (Part C) plans offer
atoms.question: What is a Medicare Advantage plan?
atoms.text: Medicare Advantage (Part C) plans offer all the benefits of Original Medicare (Part A and Part B), with extras like dental, vision, hearing, and prescription drug coverage. UnitedHealthcare lists Medicare Advantage as one of the main plan types it offers to people shopping for Medicare coverage.
questions: What does a Part C plan include?
Do Medicare Advantage plans cover dental and vision?

atoms.title: What Medicare Supplement (Medigap) plans do
atoms.question: What is a Medicare Supplement plan?
atoms.text: Medicare Supplement (Medigap) plans help pay some of the out-of-pocket costs that Original Medicare doesn't pay. They are sold by private insurers as a companion to Original Medicare rather than as a replacement for it.
questions: What does a Medicare Supplement plan pay for?
How do I cover costs Original Medicare doesn't pay?

atoms.title: What Part D prescription drug plans do
atoms.question: What is a Medicare Part D prescription drug plan?
atoms.text: Medicare Part D prescription drug plans help pay for prescription drugs. A person can combine a Part D plan with Original Medicare or with a Medicare Supplement (Medigap) plan.
questions: Can I add a drug plan to Original Medicare?
Can I use a Part D plan with Medigap?

atoms.title: What Dual Special Needs plans (D-SNPs) are
atoms.question: What is a Dual Special Needs plan?
atoms.text: Dual Special Needs plans (D-SNPs) are Part C plans designed for people who are eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid coverage. Many D-SNPs include extra benefits beyond what Original Medicare provides.
questions: Is there a Medicare plan for people with Medicare and Medicaid?
Do dual eligible plans have extra benefits?

atoms.title: UnitedHealthcare's four Medicare plan families
atoms.question: What kinds of Medicare plans does UnitedHealthcare offer?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare organizes its Medicare coverage into four plan families: Medicare Advantage plans, which bundle Part A and Part B benefits with extras; Medicare Supplement (Medigap) plans, which help with Original Medicare out-of-pocket costs; Part D prescription drug plans; and Dual Special Needs plans for people eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid.
